# ms: # The SessionEnd that follows /exit, captured so `process_exit` being unclaimed is
# a choice with evidence rather than an omission.
# It carries the real thread id and nothing else: Mastra Code's HookStdinSession
# declares session_id, cwd, hook_event_name and three optional worktree fields, and
# no reason of any kind. Kimi's SessionEnd carries reason=exit and could therefore
# distinguish an exit from any other ending; this one cannot, so an asset that
# hooked it would release the lane on every session ending whatever caused it.
# Upstream's eleven rows do not subscribe to it and neither does this port.
# The offset is 0 because this capture predates the timestamping tracer the other
# four use, and one row has nothing to be relative to.
